name: MPD
author: kokko
description: MPD client for the Omarchy bar: what is playing right now, with cover and transport, plus a panel with queue, local library search and file browser. Talks the MPD protocol directly (TCP or Unix socket); state arrives by MPD idle push instead of polling. Also runs under a third-party bar, because the connection lives as a child process inside the widget itself.

barWidget.description: What is playing right now, with cover and transport buttons. Click opens queue, search and library.

schema.label: MPD host
schema.description: Hostname or IP. A path or @name is a Unix socket. Empty follows $MPD_HOST, then 127.0.0.1.

schema.label: MPD port
schema.description: Ignored when the host is a Unix socket.

schema.label: MPD password
schema.description: Only if the server asks for one. Stored as plain text in shell.json.

schema.label: Label format
schema.description: %tag% is substituted, [ ] drops out when a tag inside it is missing, [a|b] takes the first hit.

schema.label: Label width (pixels)
schema.description: How much room the label gets before it scrolls or is cut.

schema.label: When the label is too long
Cover thumbnail in the bar
schema.description: The cover as a small image in front of the label.

schema.label: When nothing is playing
schema.description: icon keeps a glyph, hide removes the widget entirely.

schema.label: Card on hover
schema.description: Cover, progress and the big transport buttons as a card under the bar.

schema.label: Cover backdrop: presence
schema.description: 0 turns it off; higher values make the cover behind the lists more present (opacity, saturation and sharpness together) without covering the rows.

schema.label: Card on track change
schema.description: Briefly show cover, title and progress at the bottom.

schema.label: Simple card on hover as well
schema.description: Show the simple display instead of the card with controls.

schema.label: Notification on track change
schema.description: Desktop notification with cover, title and artist.

schema.label: Cover in the player
schema.description: How the band in the panel looks: classic (soft-blurred cover behind the panel), sharp (the cover stays an image), hero (cover as the card of the player), anchor (big cover, one control row). Switchable live.
